blockingFindings.summary: EPBD (EU) 2024/1275 Article 22 conflated semi-annual public national updates (Art. 22(4)) with transfers to the EU Building Stock Observatory, which Art. 22(5) sets at least once per year.
blockingFindings.resolution: Separated Art. 22(2) machine-readable national databases, Art. 22(4) at-least-twice-yearly public aggregated updates, and Art. 22(5) at-least-annual Observatory transfers across ev-pol33-epbd-art7-annex3, cl-pol33-epbd-whole-life-gwp (ZH/EN), and Table 1 (ZH/EN).

blockingFindings.summary: CBAM (EU) 2023/956 four-year record retention was cited as Article 7(5) instead of Article 7(6) (which sets retention through the end of the fourth year after the declaration submission year).
blockingFindings.resolution: Updated ev-pol33-cbam-boundary-defaults-verif, cl-pol33-cbam-boundary-defaults-verification (ZH/EN), and Table 1 (ZH/EN) to cite Article 7(5)–(6) with exact retention scope.
